name: Villamoratiel de las Matas (Spain)
description: Crimson field with a white central pale and a green horizontal stripe edged yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villamoratiel de las Matas (a tower, a column, a tree and a lion).
history: Municipal flag of Villamoratiel de las Matas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
